decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The level of illumination of the adverts will not have an adverse affect upon highway safety and is therefore in accordance with policies ENV.B.1.4 (Advertisements) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Following approval for installation of 2 internally illuminated wall mounted signs, 3 non-illuminated free standing service signs, 2D non-illuminated canopy fascia box signs, 2 - 3D internally illuminated canopy fascia box signs, 1 internally illuminated and 1 non-illuminated wall mounted COSTA signs, one internally illuminated double sided 1D sign, one internally illuminated and one non-illuminated double sided lollipop signs, one non-illuminated single sided free standing road poster sign, internally illuminated single sided wall mounted building sign and one internally and one non-illuminated single sided banner to petrol station - details submitted pursuant to condition 4 (Illumination) of approved planning permission ref 00248/C/AD18 dated 31/05/2005.
